items.title: Google Ads Coming To AI Mode With Personal Intelligence
items.excerpt: Google confirmed it will now show ads in AI Mode results with Personal Intelligence enabled. Back in March, Google said AI Mode with Personal Intelligence turned on would be ad-free, but that is now changing.

items.title: OpenAI ChatGPT Ads New Visual Ad Formats, Updated Conversion Page, Performance Emails & More
items.excerpt: OpenAI announced a number of product updates to ChatGPT Ads late Friday.  These updates include new visual ad formats, a redesigned conversions page, performance emails, new measurement partners and a bug reporting / product feedback system.

items.title: Google AI Mode Citations With Source Preferences For Preferred Sources
items.excerpt: Google is testing letting users view and modify their preferred sources list directly from within the AI Mode citations sidebar.  There is a new button named "Source preferences" and when you click on it, it opens up your preferred sources list where you can add or remove preferred sources.

items.title: monday.com's Harmony voice AI lifted car broker's deals 9%, client says
items.excerpt: Sales call agents reply in about 200ms on task-specific models and run on Twilio in four markets. What sits behind the 70% contact rate, and what stays hidden?

items.title: ChatGPT drops to 74.5% of marketers as Claude climbs to 72.3%, Basis finds
items.excerpt: Only 6.5% of 184 surveyed marketers measure AI returns against benchmarks, yet 51.1% now run agents. What happens when automation outruns the proof it works?

items.title: Meta splits one AI agent into 14 specialists after it hallucinated
items.excerpt: Prep for a new data column fell from up to four days to under an hour, Meta engineers say. Can ad tech teams running agents copy a router that reasons less?

items.title: AI Startup Minerva Built An Agentic CDP, But Don't Call It That
items.excerpt: Minerva wants to turn fragmented customer data into something marketers can use, with AI agents doing the work behind the scenes.

items.title: How Australian Home Lender Lendi Measures The Invisible Work Of AI
items.excerpt: Most brands and businesses are trying to figure out how to improve their metrics when it comes to AI – and also what those metrics even are. Problem is, measuring how chatbots shape brand discovery is mostly still a mystery. But “you can’t improve what you can’t measure,” said Michael McCash, GM of

items.title: How Amazon Ads Plans To Make Programmatic Simple Without Taking Control From Marketers
items.excerpt: Amazon Ads VP Kelly MacLean on how AI helps marketers connect the dots across the customer journey, with lower costs and better delivery.

items.title: AI Search Tools Cited A Made-Up Concept Within A Week, Paper Finds
items.excerpt: Researchers posted about a made-up concept on sites AI search tools cite. Four English-web tools cited it within a week. Other topics mostly didn't land.

items.title: Meta Drops Training From Its Crawl Clause And Keeps The Crawl
items.excerpt: Meta removed training from the crawling clause in its upcoming Commercial Terms. The permission to crawl sites tied to business users is still in place.

items.title: DeepSeek Opens Its In-House Search Engine To Developers
items.excerpt: A Chinese AI lab opened its search engine to developers. Each result carries a page-level authority tier, and DeepSeek says it filters GEO manipulation.

items.title: The AI attack-ad nightmare is coming true
items.excerpt: The Wesleyan Media Project counted $137 million spent on 220 AI-generated political ads through Oct. 11, and an Axios analysis found many midterm ads partly or fully made with generative AI, sometimes undisclosed. Only four states ban certain deepfake uses in political ads; there is no federal rule.

items.title: People are using AI to make their smart TVs dumb again
items.excerpt: Fed up with ads, tracking, and sluggish interfaces, some smart TV owners are turning to AI agents to strip away bloatware and take back control of their TVs.

items.title: Websites are closing their doors to AI agents
items.excerpt: Online roadblocks are undermining the narrative behind AI agents.

items.title: Making the internet better for AI agents might make it worse for everyone else
items.excerpt: Millions of AI agents are descending on a web built for humans. Websites are trying to keep them out, but the arrival of these new visitors could transform the internet.

items.title: The Verge switches up its audience team to prepare for Google Zero
items.excerpt: The Verge has restructured its audience development team to prioritize loyal readers over traffic and page views.

items.title: How marketers can optimize their media mix as confidence takes a turn
items.excerpt: Advertisers are upping their bets on generative artificial intelligence and creators as uncertainty lingers around their media strategies, per Kantar.

items.title: What actually happened when our blog went AI-first: A manager's account
items.excerpt: Discover how to leverage AI for content efficiency without sacrificing quality. Learn our team's proven strategies for maintaining craftsmanship.

items.title: Personal Agents Will Drive More Contact Center Traffic Than They Offset
items.excerpt: Personal agents can start a customer’s request, but the business still has to finish it.

items.title: 4 tips for styling outfits with Gemini
items.excerpt: Google shows how athlete stylist Sydney Bordonaro uses Gemini to build client outfits from screenshots and product images, pitching Gemini as a shopping and styling assistant.

items.title: Fox Advertising Expands Agentic AI Capabilities to Live, Linear
items.excerpt: Fox Advertising is extending its Fox AdStudio agent-to-agent buying platform to live and linear TV, with WPP, Omnicom, Horizon, Stagwell and Simulmedia running agent-negotiated campaigns. When requested inventory is unavailable, the Fox agent proposes alternatives matched to the advertiser's audience.

items.title: Meta outlines Muse AI use cases for businesses
items.excerpt: Meta shared the most common ways businesses are using its Muse AI tools so far, based on early examples from advertisers.
